metadata.description:
One set

Disc One
xx - Sharecropper's Son (missing - not taped)
01 - "If the show gets too smooth for you..."
02 - Big Spike Hammer
03 - "We call him Burle..."
04 - Ain't Been Myself in Years
05 - "We've seen this place on TV.."
06 - Years With Rose > Good Hearted Woman
07 - The Crooked Hitch
08 - Red Rocking Chair
09 - "I wanted to do laps in a golf cart.."
10 - 8 Cylinders
11 - "Beautiful day, good way to spend it.."
12 - If Loving You is Killing Me
13 - tuning
14 - Maid of the Canyon
15 - Angel

Disc two
01 - "We're having a bug eating competition.."
02 - Half Moon Rising
03 - "We've got 20 minutes before things start exploding over our heads.."
04 - "Sorry, 20 minutes was a lie.."
05 - Idaho
06 - "We're gonna edge things up a little.."
07 - Little Girl of Mine From Tennessee  #
08 - "A Good Thing.."
09 - Damned if the Right One Didn't Go Wrong  #
10 - Up on the Hill Where They Do the Boogie  >  $ *
11 - Oklahoma   $  *
ENC
12 - Country Boy Rock and Roll  $
metadata.notes:
# Shawn Camp on fiddle, guitar and vocals
$ Noam Pickelney on banjo
* Shad Cobb on fiddle


Tweaked and torrented by The Yondermeister

(i've asked the taper for the exact source info, will update as
i have it).

Original files were TAO, so i did edited out the gaps with EAC and did some normalisation. The taper put most of the between song banter as seperate tracks ; i left it that way partly because i wanted get this uploaded and mostly because it reminded me of the way Pastor Tim used to track his early Yonder recordings back in 

thanks to Buddy Beavers for the seed!
